author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 10: Greedy Seed + Jittered Refinement
abstract:
This experiment synthesizes the two most successful concepts from my lineage.
It uses the randomized greedy constructive heuristic (from Exp 6) to generate a novel, high-quality seed (the ~2.61 packing).
It then applies the SOTA's powerful multi-start jittered refinement technique (from Exp 877) to this new seed.
The goal is to test if an advanced local search can elevate the novel packing to a SOTA-beating score.
